steps.note: document-start xhs-sign (logout fuse + resign) + QR create hook that stashes window.__xhs_qr. create block has no url — preload must win before first xhs navigation (same race kill as xhs-post).

default www login. Prefer a clean account-bound session (POST /session/create {account}) then flow_run with session_id — shared/dead jars get risk-checked. Engines-native QR is the path; Chrome import_curl remains the fallback when App shows 环境异常.
jsvmp signer or page QR must appear before we mint/poll. Dev builds may need AGINXBROWSER_SCRIPT_DEADLINE_MS=60000 on heavy login SPAs.

Handoff artifact: {url, qr_id, code, source}. Prefer page's own qrcode/create (source=page) — repeated manual create in one session is the 09-22 risk fingerprint. Render saved.qr.url as a QR image locally (python qrcode / any encoder) and open for the human; or watch /live?session=<id>. Do NOT mint a second QR while polling.

HUMAN: scan the QR (from saved.qr.url) with the 小红书 App and confirm BEFORE/WHILE this step runs. Page-native status polling is blind in-engine (visibility quirk) — we poll GET .../qrcode/status signed via _webmsxyw (GET-only; param names qr_id/code not qrId/xhs_code). code_status 0=wait 1=scanned 2=confirmed 3/471=dead. Fast-fail pattern: vars.login_timeout_ms=5000, take saved.qr from the failed receipt, render+scan, then poll /session/:id/eval yourself or re-run with a longer budget on the same session_id after ensure_qr (session still has __xhs_qr).
Evidence only. Persist cookies via GET /session/:id/cookies — if the session was created with account=, the engine writes the jar back after commands. Compose xhs-post with this session_id.
